usage: Used as a noun for the metal gold; very common in everyday speech and in jewellery-related topics.
Often appears in compound words like 金器 and 金戒指, especially when talking about accessories, wedding items, or valuables.
Can also be used more broadly for the colour gold or golden things, depending on context.
In casual Cantonese, 金 is a short, natural word; learners should remember the tone is high level: gam1.
